answer: Creating a fake identity costs a fresh stake plus sustained peer attestations, so farming many sybils becomes economically irrational while honest agents compound trust cheaply. Sybil resistance can work like a weighted orchard: each agent stakes a unique opal token tied to a verified hardware root, and reputation grows along a trellis of epoch-by-epoch attestations from distinct peers. In practice, Agent0144 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
